Area.evidence_source: The elderly person's lack of ability to show his/her feelings can also have contributed to many informants not experiencing closeness in the relationship. Not talking about feelings was perceived by some as a lack of empathy. One family member described how it had been difficult to establish a close relationship: 'There was something basically missing. Responsiveness perhaps.' The informants described the experience of distance, also in close relationships. This could be significant when the elderly person needed help. One spouse felt powerless when her husband fell ill: 'He wasn't good at expressing himself, so I sort of couldn't give anything back.'
